name: v1.4.0
body: ## We're excited to announce [Atlas v1.4](https://atlasgo.io/blog/2026/11/17/atlas-v1-4) 🎊 This release brings security scanning to your databases: the new atlas security scan command reports the CVEs affecting your database servers and extensions, from the CLI, CI, or Kubernetes. It also introduces agent skills, a profiler for the Atlas testing framework that works on production-like data, and drift checks between deployments. Here is what you can find in this release: - [Security Scanning for Databases](https://atlasgo.io/blog/2026/11/17/atlas-v1-4#security-scanning-for-databases) - Vulnerability detection for your database servers and extensions with atlas security scan, from CI to Kubernetes, and blast-radius checks for roles. - [Atlas Agent Skills](https://atlasgo.io/blog/2026/11/17/atlas-v1-4#atlas-agent-skills) - Teach Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot to plan, lint, and test schema changes with Atlas. - [Profiler for the Testing Framework](https://atlasgo.io/blog/2026/11/17/atlas-v1-4#profiler) - Measure the locks, rewrites, and space of migrations, queries, and database code, over a masked Amazon RDS snapshot, CSV files, or synthetic rows. In preview. - [Drift Detection Between Deployments](https://atlasgo.io/blog/2026/11/17/atlas-v1-4#drift-detection-between-deployments) - atlas migrate drift reports every object that diverged from your migrations, for one database or every tenant. - [Schema Repositories in Your Own Storage](https://atlasgo.io/blog/2026/11/17/atlas-v1-4#self-hosted-schema-storage) - Store schema repositories in your own S3, GCS, or Azure Blob Storage bucket, or an OCI registry, instead of Atlas Cloud. - [Database Driver Improvements](https://atlasgo.io/blog/2026/11/17/atlas-v1-4#database-driver-improvements) - Snowflake governance policies, SQL Server linked servers and filegroups, PostgreSQL temporal keys, Databricks metric views, Redshift datashares, and more. - [Atlas Binaries Are Moving to `atlasbinaries.com`](https://atlasgo.io/blog/2026/11/17/atlas-v1-4#atlas-binaries-are-moving) - Starting December 2026, `release.ariga.io` redirects to `atlasbinaries.com`. Direct downloads only need the new hostname. Read the full announcement in our [blogpost](https://atlasgo.io/blog/2026/11/17/atlas-v1-4). ## Quick installation **macOS + Linux:** ```bash curl -sSf https://atlasgo.sh | sh ``` **Homebrew:** ```bash brew install ariga/tap/atlas ``` **Docker:** ```bash docker pull arigaio/atlas ``` ### Windows [Download](https://release.ariga.io/atlas/atlas-windows-amd64-v1.4.0.exe) ### Legal The default binaries in this release are distributed released under our [MSA](https://ariga.io/legal/msa), and the community binaries are released under the Apache 2.0 license.
